narrative:
The consolidated FY2026 plan delivers PLN 3.33B of NII, +12.5% versus FY2025, at a net interest margin of 3.92%. That is above the 3.80% ALCO floor and 2.1% below the PLN 3.40B ambition, inside the 5% finance-gate tolerance.

The bridge tells the strategic story. The Citi retail inflow (+PLN 540M) and volume growth (+PLN 160M) more than offset NBP rate cuts (-PLN 520M). Deposit repricing (+PLN 120M), loan spread management (+PLN 40M) and hedge carry (+PLN 30M) are the management actions that protect margin.

For Tomasz Kubiak and the Management Board, the plan gives a defensible NII narrative while the new strategy is prepared, with clear sensitivities if the NBP eases faster.

signals.title: Management Commentary — Rate Headwind
signals.excerpt: Management flagged NBP rate cuts as the key earnings headwind for net interest income, with deposit pricing discipline and balance-sheet growth as offsets.

signals.title: Citi Handlowy Retail Integration Completed
signals.excerpt: Migration of the Citi Handlowy retail business completed on 15 June 2026: PLN 22.1B of deposits, PLN 6B of loans, PLN 8.9B AuM and ~1,600 employees now on VeloBank systems.

signals.title: NBP Monetary Policy Council — Rate Decision
signals.excerpt: The MPC lowered the reference rate and signalled further easing as CPI returns toward the 2.5% target. Market pricing implies a terminal rate near 3.50%.
